dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Just seeing you makes me twice as happy. This trip to Mondstadt was totally worth it!

choices.text: Do you want to grab a jacket?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, it's fine, really! It's cold, sure, but it just feels kind of new and interesting, not like I need to bundle up or anything!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If I'm being serious, I was out there using fireworks to fight monsters not long ago, so yeah, I'm still all warmed up.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Besides, there's a campfire nearby. If I ever do start feeling cold, I can just warm up there. Really, you don't have to worry about me!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If I put it in a more fun way, being surrounded by so many comic fans has the whole place buzzing, and it's got my own excitement fired up too!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I mean, you're not bundled up in a big coat either! Have a little faith in your companion! I'm tougher than I look.

choices.text: So, Yoimiya, you're here just for the competition this time?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, I just stopped by to watch the competition — my trip to Mondstadt actually has a real purpose this time...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: For the past six months, I've been looking for new materials for my fireworks. I want to make the explosions feel more alive.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I've tried pretty much every common material you can find in Inazuma by now, and some of them actually turned out really well. Like those floaty Sakura Blooms, or the peel from the Lavender Melons everyone's got at home.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: First I soak the two materials in dye for some time. After they air-dry, I give them a thin coating of gunpowder that's been mixed with a shaping binder, and make them into little firework charges...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Next I carve each tiny firework charge, balance their weights precisely, and nestle them into the tube in a custom formation...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: When the firework goes off, those little charges are blasted outward and follow the paths I planned, painting the sky with finer, more detailed patterns, sometimes even a whole picture!

choices.text: That sounds like it takes some serious calculating...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: It's not that complicated! You just keep trying, don't worry about failing, and go with what feels right in your hands. That's how you make the fireworks you want!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So, following that logic, if I want the firework's picture to stay in the sky a little longer, I'll need to find a lighter material to carry the powder.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: What kind of material could catch the night breeze and keep drifting in the sky like that?

choices.text: The first thing I thought of was... dandelions?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Bingo! We were thinking the exact same thing!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Perfect timing! There's a cross-country race going on, and the boat tickets are cheaper too. With all the excitement around, I figured I'd drop by. Part fun, part business!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: When I got to Mondstadt, I went right out and gathered a bunch of fresh dandelions. Kept them all safe and sound, and just like that, mission accomplished!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But fresh dandelions turned out to be even lighter and more fragile than I remembered. Working with them takes a really delicate touch... guess that's part of the challenge!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Once I manage to make fireworks that burn longer and shine even brighter, you'll be the first one I show them to!

choices.text: A plant unique to the land of wind, Mondstadt?
Sounds like we're drifting into engineering territory here...
What do you think of Mondstadt so far?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hmm... let me think. I've been going slow this trip. Feels like I could fall asleep anywhere in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, that's definitely a good thing! You know, when someone's got a lot on their mind, it's hard to sleep. And when everyone around is rushing about, it's even harder to really relax.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: There's this calm, easygoing feeling in Mondstadt, like the whole place is on vacation all the time. No wonder everyone's so bright and full of energy!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Klee told me the Windblume Festival is the biggest celebration in Mondstadt. But honestly, with how relaxed things are here, I think a few more festivals wouldn't hurt!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: And if that ever happens, I'll bring some of our special fireworks from home to brighten up the celebrations!

choices.text: Have you made any new friends?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Yeah, I have! It's my first time hanging out with people my age from Natlan! There's Varesa — she's Miss Bold Bang Bouldern's boss, and I heard she's an incredible wrestler!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: We grabbed a meal together, and I found out Varesa is really easy to talk to. She's got this soft, gentle way of speaking... It's almost impossible to picture her in a wrestling match!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But she's actually here to meet her pen pal this time, so she's been really busy. We didn't chat for long, just got to know each other a little.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: We both love comics, so I'm sure we'll see each other again if Inazuma ever holds another event like that.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Sure! Go take care of what you need to. Everyone in Mondstadt, Natlan, and Inazuma is counting on you!
